brief:
British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband announced Tuesday that the United Kingdom will introduce a "comprehensive" package of measures regarding Israeli settlements in the occupied West Bank over the coming weeks, Shehab Wire reported. The statement signals a potential shift in Britain's approach to the long-standing dispute over settlement construction in Palestinian territories.

Miliband did not specify which measures Britain intends to pursue or provide details on their implementation timeline beyond the stated timeframe of several weeks. The announcement comes amid sustained international criticism of Israeli settlement expansion, which much of the international community considers an obstacle to peace negotiations and a violation of international law.
